utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—9:00 works. I can bring the toolbox and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks — I’ll make sure everyone gets the update at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks. Anything else you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m still in and ready to help with the repair drive. Just point me to what’s needed, Opal, and I’ll take care of it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — I’ll send you the details and the list of spots where we need help. If you can, please keep an eye out for anyone nearby who needs small repairs.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll keep an eye out and pass the word along. Send me the details when you can, and I’ll help where I’m needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, it’s still happening—I can help spread the word and match folks up with tasks if that’d be useful. If you want, I can also check the timing details and what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: That’d be great, Jules — I’m a bit fuzzy on the details, so any update on timing and what still needs fixing would help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll check on the timing and get a quick rundown of what’s still left to fix. Then I can pass it along and help match folks up where needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It’s for folks who need help fixing up small things at home—leaky faucets, broken steps, that sort of thing. I heard we’re collecting tools and a little funding for it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, thanks. I’ll bring the toolbox and gloves, and I’m still good to leave around 9:00.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, thanks, Dane — 9:00 works. I’ll pass that along at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still checking our supplies, but batteries, duct tape, and spare tools are the big things we could use.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — so the repair drive is still on, and batteries, duct tape, and spare tools are the main things left to gather, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, that’s right — we’re still gathering those, and I’m checking what we already have so we can fill any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s still mostly supplies and a few extra hands they’re after—tools, materials, and folks to help sort everything. I’ll keep an ear out for the exact list and let you know as soon as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—just let me know when the list comes in, and I can bring a few tools or help sort supplies.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do, Gus—I'll pass it along as soon as I hear the exact list. Appreciate you being ready to help out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help around school drop-off and pickup, too—what time do you need people at the repair drive, and should I bring anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Faye — could you be there around 9:00, and please bring gloves if you have them?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I can do 9:00, and I’ll bring gloves with me. If there’s anything else you need, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 9:00 works for me. I’ll bring the toolbox and gloves—just let me know if anything else is needed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, that should cover it for now. If anything else comes up, just let me know before 9:00 and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll be ready by 9:00.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help; I can sort tools or help with simple fixes if you still need someone.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren — I could use help sorting the tools into the labeled bins at the community hall table. If you can start there, that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll head to the community hall and start sorting the tools into the labeled bins.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Nell—what’s still needed for the repair drive right now: tools, materials, or extra hands?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but it sounds like they still need extra hands and maybe some tools. I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Nell—if you hear which tools they still need, could you let me know? I can help spread the word for extra hands too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just send me the repair list and I’ll see what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do — I’ll send the repair list right away and let you know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks — I’ll look it over as soon as you send it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Rosa, I’m still coming around 2 PM with some basic tools and spare parts—do you need anything else for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mina—that’s perfect. If you can bring a few extra screws and some tape too, that would really help at the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, I can bring extra screws and tape too. See you Sunday at the community center around 2 PM.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Sam, I’m a bit late—what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries — we’ve still got a few small fixes left, and I’m sorting the tools by the garage table now. Just grab a bin and I’ll point you to the next one.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll grab a bin and head to the garage table now. Point me to the next fix when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is still on, right? I just want to make sure I’ve got that straight.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, it’s still on—it's for small home repairs, and we’re gathering tools plus a little funding too. If you want, I can help point you to the sign-up details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, that’s what I needed to confirm. Do you have the sign-up details handy?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll be there at 2 PM with some basic tools and any spare parts I have. Is there anything else you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great, Mina — if you can also bring a notebook or your phone for tracking tasks, that’d help a lot. I’ll check in on the final list and fill any gaps once it comes through.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll bring a notebook and my phone too. See you at 2 PM.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We still need a few volunteers to sort tools and help with simple fixes. If you’re free, I’d really appreciate you taking one of those spots.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can take one of those spots—what time do you need me, and what tools should I look for?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — could you be there at 10 AM and look for the tool bins, screwdrivers, and any tape or spare batteries? I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll keep asking around and let folks know—Cleo said they still need batteries, duct tape, and any spare tools.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps. I still need the pickup time and drop-off spot before I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure yet, but I’ll ask around for the pickup time and drop-off spot. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. I’m still sorting out a few things, but I’ll let you know as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Okay, thanks — just let me know when you’ve got an update.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. I appreciate your patience — I’ll be in touch soon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—10 a.m. at the school lot, and I’ll bring a screwdriver set plus any spare zip ties I have.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, Hana—thanks. I’ll bring my drill and a wrench set, and we can start with the gate and railings.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sounds good—I’ll check the gate and railings with you when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help work around school drop-off and pickup—what time are you planning the repair drive, and do you need me to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That would be wonderful, Faye—thank you. I’m still pinning down the time, but if you’ve got spare batteries, duct tape, or any basic tools, please bring them along.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can bring some basic tools and check for spare batteries and duct tape. Just let me know the final time and I’ll work around school drop-off/pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mostly supplies and a few extra hands are still needed—tools, materials, and volunteers to help sort everything. I can keep an ear out for the exact list if you want.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — that’d be really helpful. I’ll get the updated supply list together for Sunday at the community center and let everyone know we still need a few extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good, Rosa — Sunday at the community center should help a lot. I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything else I hear.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It’s for folks who need help fixing up small things at home—leaky faucets, broken steps, that sort of thing. I heard we’re collecting tools and a little funding for it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that makes sense — thanks for reminding me. I can help sort tools or pitch in with simple fixes if you still need someone.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, Oren — we could use the help sorting tools and on a few easy fixes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ve got the word out and Mina’s bringing tools and spare parts at 2 PM. If you know anyone else who can help, send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll ask around and see if I can send a few extra hands your way.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Rey! I appreciate it—send them over if you find anyone, and I’ll keep folks posted.
